title: Berserk Writer And More Honor Deceased Creator in Touching Anniversary Tribute
content: In the anime world, few creators have had as big an impact as Berserk creator Kentaro Miura. The legendary mangaka died of “aortic dissection” on May 6th, 2021, and the anime industry has never been the same.
author: ComicBook

title: N LITE Partners with Kodansha for 'Afro-Anime' Film MFINDA's Manga Adaptation
content: Entertainment news website Variety reported on Tuesday that multimedia company N LITE is partnering with Kodansha to co-develop the serialized manga adaptation of its MFINDA " AFRIME " or "afro-anime." The series will debut in Kodansha 's Biblio Sirius Magazine in 2026.
author: ANN

title: Shonen Jump Announces Sudden End of Two Major Releases
content: Shueisha has been going through some changes with the ends of some of its longer running franchises , and has announced that two of their major Jump+ releases are coming to an end very soon.
author: ComicBook

title: Black Clover Reveals Release Date for Final Manga Release
content: Black Clover has ended its run after 11 long years with Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump magazine, and a release date has been set for its final volume. Black Clover officially kicked off the final arc of its run back in 2023 with a shift in schedule.
author: ComicBook

title: Godzilla, Straight Outta Compton Star Crowns One Piece’s Worst Story
content: One Piece has told quite a few stories over the course of its decades-long history, seeing the Straw Hat Pirates encounter enemies, allies, and everything in between while sailing the Grand Line.

content: Crunchyroll has launched a new English dub release as part of their Spring 2026 anime schedule , but it’s keeping one major character’s voice a secret until it’s all over. title: Kanojo no Tomodachi Manga Gets TV Anime
content: Jura 's Kanojo no Tomodachi (My Girlfriend's Friend) is getting a television anime adaptation in 2026. Jura drew a commemorative illustration for the announcement: Jura debuted the manga in Kodansha 's YanMaga Web in May 2021. Kodansha published the manga's sixth compiled book volume last October.
author: ANN

title: Jujutsu Kaisen Originally Didn’t Plan to Bring Back Characters in Sequel
content: Jujutsu Kaisen wrapped up its official sequel story earlier this year after a brief six month serialization , and it turns out that the creator behind it all originally didn’t plan to bring back any of the characters from the original series.
author: ComicBook

title: Manga 'Kanojo no Tomodachi' Gets TV Anime in 2026
content: WWWaveCorporation 's Deregula animation label announced a television anime adaptation of Jyura 's Kanojo no Tomodachi ( My Girlfriend's Friend ) manga on Wednesday, revealing an illustration drawn by the creator (pictured above). The anime series is scheduled to premiere in 2026.
